༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung 'khor bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsdus pa/bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'kho

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung 'khor bsdus pa bzhugs so// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsdus pa/ bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /thugs dkyil la sogs bsdus pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur don/ /srung 'khor bsdus pa bshad par bya/ /'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la kha lag dag pa'i cho ga sku gsung thugs ye shes sbyang ba/ lus la rigs drug dgod pa/ yan lag drug dgod pa/ yan lag drug dgod pa'i cho ga zhing skyong dang gnas bdag mchod pa/ bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur sgom pa/ bdud gzhom pa'i cho ga bgegs la phur bus gdab pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po gnyis sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ las snang mtha' dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas tho ba/ mdung / rtse gsum/ g.yon pad dkar 'dab brgya/ me long bgrang phreng / mgrin par āḥlas rin 'byung dmar po/ dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra bcas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gzhu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rin chen cha dgu pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las don grub nag po/ nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po/ lte bar hoḥlas rnam snang ser po/ ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ rdo rje gdengs pa/ g.yon dung / lcags sgrog sgra bcas dril bu/ gtsug tor du haṃ las mi bskyod pa ljang khu/ ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs mgo gsang bar k+ṣaḥlas rdor sems sngon po/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag mtshan snga ma dang 'dra ba bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bo gnyis kyi snying khar reg ste/ oṃ hral̥ṃ hṛ da yā ya na maḥ mgor oṃ hūṃ si ra se swā hā/ gtsug tor du oṃ hraṃ shi khā ye bau ṣaṭa/

yan lag thams cad la oṃ hṛṃ ka ba tsa ye hūṃ/ mig la oṃ hrām̐ nai tra ya ba ṣaṭa/ dge ba la g.yon/ mi dge ba la g.yas kyi mtheb mdzub kyi se gol gyis mtshon cha dgod cing / oṃ hṝḥ asatra ya phaṭa ces brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya si ra shi khā ka ba tsa nai tra asatra badz+ra ṣa ḍaṃ ga swa bhā wa āt+ma ko haṃ gis nga rgyal gzung ngo / /yang lte bar reg cing / oṃ hral̥ṃ nā bh+yo na maḥ snying khar oṃ hṛ da yā ya swā hā/ mgrin par oṃ hraṛṃ gṝ yai bau ṣaṭa/ dpral bar oṃ hṛṃ la la ṭa ye hūm̐/ gtsug tor du oṃ hrām̐ shi khā ye ba ṣaṭa/ gsang gnas su/ oṃ hrāḥ gu h+ya ya phaṭa ces brjod do/ /lnga pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis 'og nas 'chad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs te 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgyas yul bdag gam zhing skyong spyan drang zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ chai mo sa pa ri wā rā ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gan dhaṃ puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ pra dī pa ak+ṣa taṃ da dā ma he sa pa ri wā raḥ shī gh+raṃ ā gats+tsha tu dzaḥhuṃ baṃ hoḥ i daṃ ba li gṛṃh+na tu khā da tu pi wa tu sa pa ri wā ra kaḥsarba satwo nāṃ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ rak+ṣa ā wa ra ṇa gup+tiṃ ka ro tu i daṃ s+d+ya naṃ t+yaka twā ba h+yai maṇ+ḍal bh+ya myāṃ tiṣ+ṭha tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hās gtor ma dang po zhing skyong la phul te/ chai'i gnas su yul lam grong gi ming yig mnyam pa'i thog mtha' dang mi mnyam pa'i dbus dang gsum bcug 'og ma la yang sbyar/ mthar bdud rtsis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa 'di'i zhing skyong 'khor bcas la/ /gtor ma dri dang me tog spos/ /sgron ma 'bras bu ma nyams par/ /bcas 'di khyed la bdag 'bul gyi/ /'khor bcas myur tu byon par mdzod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥgator ma 'di/ /bzung nas gsol zhing btung mdzad de/ /'khor dang bcas pas sems can la/ /zhi dang rgyas shing bsrung ba dang / /bskyab dang sba ba dag tu mdzod/ /gnas 'di dor nas phyi rol du/

/dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas mdzod/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa rdo rje 'dzin gyis/ /ji ltar bsgo bzhin mdzod swā hā/ /'di sa bzung ba'i dus su bya ste/ gzhan du i daṃ nas tiṣ+ṭha'i bar dor la swās+d+yā naṃ gats+tsha gzhug cing / gnas 'di sogs rkang pa gnyis dor ro/ /khyi'i phyag rgyas grong dang gnas bdag spyan drang zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ chai mo ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha shī gh+raṃ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+na bhuka twa pi twa trip+tiṃ kṛ twā sarba satwā na shān+tiṃ tsit+tiṃ kṛ twā a pa ras+d+yā naṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha swā hās gtor ma gnyis pa dbul/ bdud rtsis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grong dang gnas bdag rnams myur du/ /tshur byon tshur byon gtor ma 'di/ /bzung zhing bzung nas gsol ba dang / /'thungs te tshim par byas nas su/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad la/ /zhi ba'i sems su byas nas ni/ /'di las gzhan pa'i gnas nyid du/ /byon zhing byon nas rgyas par mdzod/ /ces phrin las gzhol te 'di yang sa bzung ba ma yin pa'i dus su a pa ras+d+yā naṃ gi gnas su sas+d+yā naṃ dang / 'di sogs kyi gnas su/ rang nyid gnas pa'i gnas nyid du/ /zhes zhugs shing gshegs gsol lo/ /drug pa ni/ dpral bar zla ba la oṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse mo bcu bdun pa/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥlas rdo rje dmar po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ snying khar sgra gcan nag po la hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse mo dgu pa/ lte bar dus me ser po la ho las rdo rje ser po rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa/ /gtsug tor du nam mkha' ljang khu la rdo rje ljang khu rtse lnga pa/ gsang bar ye shes sngon po la rdo rje sngon po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ g.yon pa'i dpung pa'i rtsa la nga ngi ngaṛ ngu ngl̥ ngaṃ/ gha ghi ghṛ ghu ghl̥ ghaṃ/ ga gi gṛ gu gl̥ gaṃ kha khi khṛ khu khl̥ khaṃ/ ka ki kṛ ku kl̥ kaṃ ste thung ngu dang / g.yas pa'i rtsa la k+kāḥ k+karā k+kū k+kaṝ k+kī k+kā/

kh+khāḥkh+khal̥̄ kh+khū kh+khaṝ kh+khā/ g+gāḥg+gal̥̄ g+gū g+gaṝ g+gāṃ g+gā gh+gā+-iḥgh+gī gh+gū gh+gā+-i gh+gī gh+gā/ ng+ngāḥngangl̥̄ ng+ngū ng+ngaṝ ng+ngī ng+ngā ste ring po las rdo rje ljang khu/ nye ba'i dpung pa g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la tsa sde thung ring las rdo rje nag po/ mkhrig ma g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la ṭa sde thung ring las rdo rje dmar po/ dpyi g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la pa sde thung ring las rdo rje dkar po/ pus mo g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la ta sde thung ring las rdo rje ser po/ long bu g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la sa sde thung ring las rdo rje sngon po ste rtse mo sum cu gnyis dang / g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bo'i bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs kyi rtsa la nga ngi ng+ng-i ngu ngl̥ ngaṃ dang / de bzhin du/ gha ga kha ka rnams las sbyar ba dang / g.yas kyi mthe bo nas mthe'u chung gi bar rtsa ba'i tshigs kyi rtsa la/ k+kāḥk+kal̥̄ k+kū k+kaṝ k+kī k+kā dang / de bzhin du/ kh+khāḥsogs la sbyar ba las rdo rje ljang khu/ sor tshigs bar ma'i rtsa la tsa sde thung ring las rdo rje nag po rtse mo'i tshigs kyi rtsa la ṭa sde thung ring las rdo rje dmar mo/ rkang sor gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs kyi rtsa la pa sde thung ring las rdo rje dkar po/ bar tshigs kyi rtsa la ta sde thung ring las rdo rje ser po/ rtse mo'i tshigs kyi rtsa la sa sde thung ring las rdo rje sngon po ste/ drug cu po thams cad kyang rtse mo bdun pa'o/ /de bzhin rna ba g.yon g.yas la a ā las rdo rje ljang / sna bug g.yon g.yas la e ai las rdo rje nag mig g.yon g.yas la ar ār las rdo rje dmar/ lce lce chung la o au las rdo rje dkar/ rdo rje dang gsang ba bshang laṃ la al āl las rdo rje ser/ yid dang khu ba'i rtsa a wa dhū tī'i ya sna ma sna la aṃ āḥlas rdo rje sngon po ste rtse mo gsum pa'o/ /gtsug tor dang mgo bo la ha hā las rdo rje ljang / lce dang rkan la ya yā las rdo rje nag

lag mthil g.yon g.yas la ra rā las rdo rje dmar/ rkang mthil g.yas la wa wa las rdo rje dkar/ bshang lam gyi g.yon g.yas su la lā las rdo rje ser po rtse mo lnga pa dgod de/ de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur bsgom mo/ /bdun pa ni/ rdo rje de rnams las rang 'dra'i rdo rje rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i me 'bar ba ljang khu rnams ste/ sngon po 'og nag po shar shar lho/ dmar po lho lho nub/ dkar po byang byang shar/ ser po nub nub byang du spros pas phyogs bcur gnas pa'i bdud tshogs sems can la 'tshe ba rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bsregs nas thal bar gyur par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥhraḥhraḥhraḥhraḥr ra ra ra badz+ra a na la sar+b+ba ā wa ra ṇa dharmā pra la ya swa bhā wa sarba mā ra kā yi ga bigh+na bi nā ya ka a di naṃ da sha dig ga tā nāṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta ni da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bhasmi ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod do/ /brgyad pa ni/ bdud bgegs log 'dren gzhan du bros pa dang ma tshig pa rnams rdo rje shugs kyi rdo rje lcags kyus bkug mi g.yo bas zhags pas bcings/ mtha' yas brtson 'grus kyis ha ya ra wa la thung ring las skyes pa'i rdo rje phur bu stod khro bo zhal drug phyag drug pa/ lte ba'i 'og mdung gi rtse mo'i rnam pas phyogs bcur bgegs kyi steng du btab par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ haṃ haṃ k+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa te ṣaṇa mu kha ṣaṭa bhu dza tsa ra nga sarba bigh+na bi nā ya ka a dhi duṣ+ṭha nāṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na kī la ya kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang / de nas dbyug sngon gyi tho bas brdungs par mos te/ oṃ ll̥̄ḥbadz+ra mud ga ra ma ra a dī naṃ si ra si kaṇa ṭhe hri da ye/ na bh+yau gu h+ya an te badz+ra kī la ya kan ā ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya k+ṣaṃ k+ṣāṃ k+ṣ-iṃ k+ṣā+-iṃ k+ṣ+r-iṃ k+ṣṝṃ k+ṣuṃ k+ṣūṃ k+ṣl̥ṃ k+ṣl̥̄ṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar phug gser gyi sa gzhi dang sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ror gyur pas bsam mo/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rten bskyed pa/ brten pa bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ dbus su hāṃ yāṃ raṃ wāṃ laṃ brtsegs pa bsam ste/ oṃ hāṃ yāṃ rāṃ wāṃ lāṃ badz+ra ā kā sha bā yu te dza u da ka pṛtha wī badz+ra swā bhā wa pañtsa dhā ta bo badz+ra maṇ+ḍa lā ni ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes brjod pas haṃ las nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum nor bus mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po pad+mas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ so so'i steng 'og tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes brgyan par gyur gcig tu 'dres oṃ āḥhūm̐ ra brtsegs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ra badz+ra tsan+d+ra sūr+ya ra hu kā la ag+na ye kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra prā kā rān ku ru ku ru zhes brjod pas nam mkha' dang sa 'byar ba zlum por snang ba'i mtshams nas ra ba gsum dang / yul 'khor gyi mtshams su ra ba lnga dang / dbus su rdo rje'i sa yul 'khor gyi mthar thug pa dang / 'og tu mdung dang mda'i dra ba rnon pos khyab pa'i dbus su hūm̐ bsam zhing / oṃ hūm̐ bi shwa kā ya badz+ra kū ṭa ga raṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas de'i dbus su khang pa brtsegs pa steng 'og tu khru nyis brgya pa'i nang du l̥ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa khog pa stong pa'i dkyil du paḥbasam zhing / oṃ paḥbi shwa badz+ra pad+maṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas pad+ma 'dab brgyad khru bcu gnyis pa lte ba la khru bzhi yod pa'i steng du raḥbasam zhing / oṃ raḥbadz+ra sūr+ya ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa dang /

phyogs bcur nyi ma'i gdan bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa la/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug rdo rje dgod pa/ dbang bskur ba rgyas gdab pa/ nga rgyal gzung ba'o/ /dang po la/ bdag nyid shugs su bskyed nas nga rgyal gzung ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi sa dang slob ma bsrung phyir 'khor spro ba'o/ dang po ni/ de'i steng du bdag nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po/ nag dmar dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang / sngo dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi re re'ang mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar ser du 'dug pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag gnyis pa dmar/ gsum pa dkar ba/ kha dog de dang mtshungs pa'i dpung pa drug drug phyag nyer bzhi/ lhag ma gnyis g.yas nag g.yon ser ba/ phyag rnams kyi mthe bong ser/ mdzub mo dkar/ gung mo dmar/ ming med nag mthe'u chung ljang / sor mo rnams kyi tshigs dang po nag gnyis pa dmar/ gsum pa dkar ba/ kha dog de dang mtshungs pa'i zhabs g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar bas bdud 'dod lha dang / nyon mongs dbang phyug gi snying khar g.yas brkyang gis mnan par bsgoms la phyag rgya dgod de/ so so'i sa bon las phyag rgya so sor gyur pa bkod par bsgoms la so so'i phyag rgya bca' zhing / oṃ haṃ haḥbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kar+ṇa yor badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis rna ba g.yon g.yas la rus pa las byas pa'i rdo rje'i rna rgyan/ de bzhin du mgor oṃ dang / mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar te/ aṃ āḥkaṭ+yaṃ kaṇa ṭhe badz+ra me kha lā badz+ra kaṇa ṭhi kes rked mgul rgyan/ a ā bā mā dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa kaus phyag gdub/ ha hā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa badz+ra pā da yor badz+ra nū pū res zhabs gdub/ haṃ baṃ pañtsa a kā ra ma hā shū n+ya swa bhā wa badz+ra shi ra si sarbaṃ ge bhasmas spyi bor nor bu dang lus thams cad la thal ba/

oṃ ar dha nā rī shwa ra badz+wa ar dha tsan+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ur dhes mtshogs ma'i g.yon du zla phyed dpral bar dar dpyangs/ a āḥ.aṃ sarba swa rai ka tṛ swā bhā wa badz+ra ya dz+nyā+o pa bi ta skan dhes phrag par rdo rje mchod phyir thogs bcings par bsams te/ drug ni phyin drug dag pa'o/ /de bzhin du k+ṣaḥdur dān+da bhi mā nā k+ṣa yaṃ ka ra byā gh+ra tsar ma ka ṭaus rked par stag lpags/ haṃ k+ṣaḥtriṃ shwad swa ra sap+ta ti hra swa dīr+gha byañdza na swa bhā wa dai t+ya ku la sha ta si ro bhir mud ḍa ma la skan dha ā ba laṃ bi ni skan dhes phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo phreng / ha hi hṛ hu hl̥ pañtsa skan dha bi shud+dhā swa bhā we shi ra si ka pā la mā les dbu re re la thod pa rdzogs pa kha dog lnga'i phreng ba ste/ glang lpags dang bcas pa bzhis phar phyin phyi ma dag pa ste/ gnas kyi dbye bas bcu drug ni stong nyid bcu drug dag pa'o/ /de bzhin du g.yas kyi phyag dang po bzhir/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra kro dha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa kyis khro bo'i rdo rje de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ tri shū la rtse gsum/ karta ris gri gug dmar po bzhir bā ṇas mda'/ aṃ ku shas lcags kyu/ ḍa ma ru kas ḍa ma ru/ mud ga ras tho ba/ dkar po bzhir/ tsakras 'khor lo/ kun tas mdung / daṇa ḍas dbyug pa/ par shus dgra sta/ g.yon gyi nag po bzhir/ oṃ hwaṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥphreṃ phaṭa kyis rdo rje dril bu/ de bzhin sbyar/ khe ṭa hos phub/ kha ṭ+waṃ gas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā las thod pa/ dmar po bzhir/ tsā pas gzhu/ pa shas zhags/ rat+nas rin po che/ pad+mas pad+ma/ dkar po bzhir shaṃ khas dung / ā dar shas me long / shriṃ kha lā+es lcags sgrog tsa tur be da swa bhā brah+ma shi raṃ gis tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa/ oṃ k+ṣa k+ṣa k+ṣi k+ṣī k+ṣ+r-i k+ṣṝ k+ṣu k+ṣū k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaḥ ha hā hi hī hṛ hṛ hu hū hl̥ hl̥ haṃ haḥ sarba bigh+na bi da ri ta ga dza tsar ma pa ṭa a tra rak+ta shra bta hūm̐ phreṃ gis glang lpags rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa mgo g.yas su bstan te gyon pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas phyag tha ma gnyis kyis gzung ste 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/

oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dza ya nā gen+d+ra badz+ra dza ḍa mu ku ṭa ban dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis rgyal ba ljang khus ral pa la cod pan/ de bzhin du mgor oṃ dang / mthar tiṣ+ṭha sogs sbyar te/ k+ṣuṃ badz+ra bi dza ya nā gen+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭas rnam rgyal sngon pos dar dpyangs/ h+laṃ h+lāṃ badz+ra karko ṭa ka badz+ra pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kuṇ+ḍa la yoḥs stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag pos g.yon g.yas kyi rna rgyan/ hraṃ hra badz+ra bā su ki shaṃ khā pā lau bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yoḥs nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar pos g.yon g.yas kyi phyag gdub/ hwaṃ hwaṃ badz+ra anan+ta ku le ka me khā lā kaṇa ṭhi ka yoḥs mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar pos ska rags mgul rgyan/ h+laṃ h+laṃ badz+ra tak+ṣa ko ma hā pad mau bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da nu pu ra yoḥs 'jog po dang pad chen ser pos g.yon g.yas kyi rkang gdub tu bcings par mos la/ oṃ hūm̐ kro dhen dro haṃ kro dha naṃ adz+nyā da ya ka swā hās nga rgyal gzung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ snying kha'i nyi mar/ h+ya y+yā rarā w+wā l+lā brtsegs pa'i ha dang rdo rje las/ gtsug tor ljang khu mi bskyod pa dang / hā dang rdo rje las gnod mdzes rdor sems lta bur gyur pa/ oṃ haṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza ma hā uṣ+ṇi ṣa ur dha di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā oṃ haḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza su m+bha ā dho di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ra swā hās/ bka' bsgos nas/ rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung / steng 'og gi rtsibs su nyi mar 'khod/ de bzhin du sngags kyi mtha' thog sbyar zhing / yi yī dang ral gri las bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon don grub lta bur gyur/ yaṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza a dhi ba la sarba bigh+nan ta ka pūrba dang / yāḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza nī la daṇ+ḍa ag+ne yaṃ gis bka' bsgos/ sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung / shar dang mer nyi mar 'khod/ ṛ ṝ da rin chen las shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod rgyal rin 'byung lta bur gyur/

raṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza dzam+bha ka duṣ+ṭa pra dz+nyā na ta ka dak+ṣi ṇa dang / raḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza ṭak+ki n+ye ri t+yaṃ gis bka' bsgos mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung / lho dang bden bral du nyi mar 'khod/ wu wū dang pad+ma las pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba snang mtha' lta bur gyur/ waṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza man ka bi ra ga pad+mā na ta ka ut+ta ra dang / waḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la ī shwa nas bka' bsgos/ lce dang chu lam nas phyung / /byang dang dbang ldan du nyi mar 'khod/ l̥ l̥̄ dang 'khor lo las gshin rje mthar byed/ stobs po che snang mtha' lta bur gyur/ laṃ badz+ra kro dhā rā dza stam+bha ka ya mān+ta ka ya pash+tsi mas dang / laḥbadz+ra kro dha rā dza ma hā bā la bā ya byaṃ gis bka' bsgos/ bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas phyung / nub dang rlung du nyi mar 'khod/ thams cad kyang skra dmar ser gyis rgyan du brdzes pa/ sbrul dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang dzaḥzhes brjod/ rang las rang 'dra spros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs rang la bstims te mchod/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang hūm̐ gis shes rab mthar byed kyis gzhug zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang baṃ gyis gshin rje mthar byed kyis dbyer med du bcing / dril bu'i phyag rgya dang hos pad+ma mthar byed kyis mnyes par byas/ dbyug pa'i phyag rgya dang his bgegs mthar byed kyis ro mnyam par byas par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni sngar ltar rdo rje'i sa bon rnams 'god pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sgrub thabs ltar dbang bskur rgyas par blang bar bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gtso bo dang gtsug tor la mi bskyod pa/ bgegs mthar byed dang / dbyug sngon la don grub shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod rgyal la rin 'byung / pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba la snang mtha'/ gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che la rnam snang /

gnod mdzes la rdor sems rnams sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu rgyan par bsam mo/ /drug pa ni/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣaṃ tsakra swa bhā wa at+ma ko haṃ gis nga rgyal bzung bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ snying kha'i nyi mar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs 'od kyi rnam par bsdus/ sngags phreng la thim/ 'od phyogs bcur 'phros/ bdud bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam zhing / sngags don dran bzhin pas/ oṃ na mo badz+ra satwa ya/ na mo bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra kro dhen+d+ra rā dze bh+yaḥ na mo bi shwa mā tre/ na mo bud+dha bo dhi satwa de wī bh+yaḥn mo badza ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ.aṃ na mo bha ga wā te kā la tsa krā ya/ badz+ra bhair wa bhī ka rā ya ma hā in+d+ra nī la warna sha ri rā ya/ mā ra kle sha hri da ya krān ta si ta rak+ta tsa ra ṇā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa rak+ta si ta kaṇa ṭhā ya/ nī la si ta pī ta rak+ta daṃṣ+ṭ+ra ka ra lo gra bhīṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa rak+ta si ta sa bye ta raskan dhā ya/ dwa da sha bhū dzā ya/ ṣaṭa biṃ sha ti ka rā ya/ badz+ra khaṭa ga tri shū la/ karti ka bā na/ aṃ ku sha ḍa ma ru ka mud ga ra/ tsakra/ kun ta/ daṇ+ḍa par shu/ badz+ra ghaṇa ṭā/ khe ṭa/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga ka pā la/ tsā pa/ pā sha rat+na/ ka ma la/ shaṃ kha/ ā ngar+sha/ shrīṃ kha lā/ brah+ma shi ro/ ga dza tsarma dh-i ka ka ra ya/ byā gh+ra tsarma ni wa sa nā ya/ skan dhe muṇ+ḍa mā la a ba laṃ bi ne/ shi ra si badz+ra paṭ+ṭa/ mu ku ṭe/ badz+ra ka pā la mā la/ ar dha tsan+d+ra rā ya/ kuṇ+ḍa la/ ru tsa ka kan ṭhi ka me kha la/ nū pu ra/ bhasma yadz+nyo pa bī ta/ shi ro ma ṇi/ ma hā mu dra/ nā gen+d+ra/ bi bhu ṣa ṇa ya/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni san+to shi ta hri da yā ya/ in+d+ra ag+ni ya ma nai rit+ya ba ru ṇa bā yu ku be ra ī sha na brah+ma biṣ+ṇu bi nā ya ka kārti ke ya nan ti ma hā kā la gra ha nak+ṣe tra k+ṣe tra pa la su ren+d+ra a su ren+d+ra pha ṇīn+d+ra bhu ten+d+ra na ren+d+ra saṃ tu ta tsa ra ṇā ya/

zhes rkang pa bcu drug pa dang / sngar gyi bka' bsgo ba'i sngags bzlas so/ /gsum pa rjes la mchod pa/ bstod pa/ gtor ma/ gshegs gsol bzhi'i dang po ni/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod rdzas bsangs sbyangs/ chu gnyis dang lha mo bcu gnyis dang bdud rtsis mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /zhabs la srid gsum gyis bstod pa/ /rdo rje'i shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha ya ra wa la las skyes/ /rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po che/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams gnas nas/ /phyogs bcu srung mdzad rnams la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod do/ /gsum pa ni/ ji ltar 'byor ba'i gtor ma gcig drug bdun la sogs pa sgrub thabs ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po me 'bar ba'i steng du āḥlas bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ rāḥlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la/ a i ṛ u l̥ las dbus su khu ba/ shar du rkang / lhor khrag byang du dri chu/ nub tu bshang ba/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā las rlung du glang po'i sha dbang ldan du ba lang / srin por rta/ mer khyi/ dbus su mi'i sha rnams sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa bsams la/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i rlung gis me sbar te zhu ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsi nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog lta bur gyur/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la oṃ bsams pa gtor ma la bstan te/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shud+dha ཿsā bhā wa sarba dharman bi sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas oṃ las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi la phog pas mi gtsang ba'i dri ma sbyangs/

lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la āḥbasams pa bstan te/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dharmā sarba dharmā pra bo dha ka sarba dharmān pra bo dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas aḥlas 'phros pa phog pa bdud rtsi chags pa'i ro dang ldan par rtogs par bsam/ lag pa gnyis ka kha sbub pa'i snyim par sgra gcan la hūm̐ bsams pa bstan te/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la sarba pra dī pa ka sarba dharman pra bo dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od phog pas mang por spel te gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par bsam/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcas pa'i steng du dus me'i steng du hoḥbasams bstan te/ oṃ ho sarba dharmā badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmā na badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ho las 'phros pa'i 'od kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug pa thim pas zag bcas kyi dri ma sbyangs nas zag med kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas gtor ma'i mdun du spyan drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing / gtso bo la oṃ aḥhūm̐ hoḥshri kā la tsakra/ badz+ra bhai ra ba bh+yaḥ sa pā ri wā re bh+yaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ gan dhaṃ puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ dī paṃ a k+ṣa taṃ da dā ma he te dza a gat+ya sa pa ri wā ra shi gh+raṃ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ khā dan+tu pi wan+tu dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho saṃ trip+tāḥsarba satwa naṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ rak+ṣa ā wa ra ṇa gup+tiṃ kurban tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā dang / khro bo la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bigh+nan ta ka nī la daṇ+ḍa/ pradz+nyān+ta ka ṭak+ki rā dza/ pad+mān ta ka a tsa la/ ya mān ta ka ma hā bā le bh+yaḥs pa ri wā ra sogs kyis dbul/ lha mo bcu gnyis dang bdud rtsis mchod/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /gtor ma dri dang me tog spos/ /sgron ma ma nyams 'bras bcas 'di/

/bdag gis 'bul gyis khyed rnams kyang / /'khor dang bcas pa myur gshegs nas/ /gtor ma 'di ni bsnams nas kyang / /gsol zhing btung bar mdzad nas su/ /yang dag mnyes pa sems can kun/ /zhi dang rgyas dang bsrung ba dang / /sba ba rnams ni mdzad pa dang / /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzod/ /ces pas phrin las bcol lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ yi ge k+ṣa dang lag pa'i rgyab bstan pa'i se gol gyis gsang gnas kyi 'khor lor haṃ la khro bo rnams gshegs su gsol lo/ /dkyil chog gi dus su thun mtshams gsum du gtor ma sbyin pa'i tshul yang 'di nyid de/ 'di'i rjes la sa bzung ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /thugs dkyil sogs su dbang bskur ba'i/ /sa gzhi yongs bzung dus nyid du/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'i tshul/ /bkod pa'i dge bas sangs rgyas shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung 'khor bsdus pa/ bla ma ye shes dbang phyug gis bskul ba'i ngor/ a wa dhū tī pa bsod nams kyis/ sna tshogs dbyig gi lo smal po'i zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rgyal mtshan bzang po'o/ /'dis bdud thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 bla ma dam pa/ dus 'khor gyi srung 'khor bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
